caption: 「先生，你在跟誰講話？」
scene: A crowded subway car, a security guard with his hand hovering over a walkie-talkie, staring suspiciously. In the center, a man in his 40s with messy curly hair, round glasses and a navy blue hoodie freezes mid-gesture, hand raised in the air, mouth open. Next to him a small translucent glowing cyan blonde hologram girl in an oversized white hoodie crouches by the priority seat, covering her face. Passengers turning their heads, harsh fluorescent subway lighting.

caption: 「你剛剛在說『不要在捷運上聞人家的保溫瓶』。」
scene: Close-up of the security guard's deadpan suspicious face, one eyebrow raised, walkie-talkie in hand. Behind him the man in the navy hoodie sweats with an awkward forced smile, a thermos bottle tipping nearby. The glowing hologram girl peeks out from behind his shoulder making a guilty wince. Fluorescent subway light, cramped composition.

caption: 「選民要的是溫度，不是演算法。」
scene: A meeting room. A pompous older man with slicked grey hair in a three-piece suit leans back smugly, gesturing dismissively, a few people around the table smirking. The man in the navy hoodie sits calmly, round glasses catching the light, while the glowing hologram girl floats beside him with a red warning glow. Whiteboard covered in scribbles, cold office lighting.

caption: 「你這張圖，兩組基準放一起比。」
scene: The man in the navy hoodie stands at a whiteboard, marker in hand, rewriting numbers with sharp confident strokes. The pompous older man's smug lean collapses, shrinking backward in his chair, face draining pale. Around the table people lean forward, one person's pen falling mid-air. Dramatic side lighting, the glowing hologram girl hovering with a satisfied smirk.

caption: 「不是疏漏，是你根本沒看。」
scene: Wide shot of the meeting room gone silent. The pompous older man in the suit stares at the whiteboard, jaw slack, sweat on his brow. The man in the navy hoodie sets down the marker with calm authority, round glasses glinting. A young sidekick with messy hair and round glasses drops his pen, eyes wide. The glowing cyan hologram girl gives a tiny triumphant fist pump. Harsh overhead light, dramatic stillness.

caption: 【叮！阿凱對你的崇拜度：+40%】
scene: A narrow stairwell. The young sidekick with messy hair and round glasses grabs the man in the navy hoodie's arm, eyes sparkling with admiration, mouth open in awe. The glowing hologram girl floats above them, arms crossed, smug and proud, a translucent notification glow around her. Warm afternoon light through a small window, intimate close composition.

caption: 「原來滷肉飯這麼漂亮。」
scene: A small street stall at dusk, warm yellow lantern light, steam rising from a pot. An elderly Taiwanese grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron pushes a bowl of braised pork rice toward the man in the navy hoodie, who holds chopsticks with trembling hands, eyes glistening. The tiny glowing hologram girl presses herself against the bowl's rim, eyes wide and wistful, faintly translucent. Tender, nostalgic lighting.

caption: 「這個聲音的真實度——只有 3%。」
scene: A dark apartment at night. The man in the navy hoodie grips a phone to his ear, face frozen in horror, lit only by cold blue phone glow and streetlight through the window. The glowing hologram girl hovers beside him, hood fallen, blonde hair loose, expression terrified, a red warning glow pulsing around her. Deep shadows, tense claustrophobic composition.
